items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: Joe Oliver gave me that mute.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember the place was the fire station in the days I knew it. That's it. That's it. Had been a theater and everything, I think, there at one time, in the nightclub up above, was it?
It was upstairs, I know. I used to hear that Joe Oliver, where he could play.
Do you remember anything about the whole band, how big a band it was, and who else was in it then?
